elements.description:
Fields extracted from a document, each linked to its box on the page: confidence per field, accept, correct or
reject, field by field from the keyboard while the page view follows.

properties.name: fields
properties.description: The reviewed fields – the value. Each review replaces the list (tc-fields-change)

properties.name: pages
properties.description: The document's pages, in order: an image URL and its size in pixels per page

properties.name: source
properties.description: The document the fields came from, e.g. "invoice-2041.pdf" – shown under the heading and in page alt texts

properties.name: threshold
properties.description: Confidence below this (0–1) marks a field "Low" so people check it first

properties.name: confirmLabel
properties.description: The label of the button that hands the reviewed fields back

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-fields-change
events.description: A field was accepted, corrected, rejected or set back to review. Cancelable. Detail: ExtractionFieldsChange ({ fields, field, action })

events.name: tc-confirm
events.description: Confirm was pressed with every field reviewed. Detail: ExtractionConfirm ({ fields })

props.name: title
props.description: Names the review – the heading over the page and the fields

props.name: fields
props.description: The reviewed fields. Controlled when defined – pass back what onFieldsChange reports

props.name: onFieldsChange
props.type: (fields: ExtractionField[], field: ExtractionField, action: ExtractionAction) => void
props.description: A field was accepted, corrected, rejected or set back to review: the whole list, the changed field and what was done

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Confirm was pressed with every field reviewed

props.name: title
props.description: Names the review – the heading over the page and the fields

props.name: fields
props.description: The reviewed fields. Controlled when defined – pass back what onFieldsChange reports

props.name: onFieldsChange
props.type: (fields: ExtractionField[], field: ExtractionField, action: ExtractionAction) => void
props.description: A field was accepted, corrected, rejected or set back to review: the whole list, the changed field and what was done

props.name: onConfirm
